messages.author: 5d4f9e7f97c21008
messages.subject: Re: plotProbe() - formating
parts:
Hi Carsten,

plotProbe currently uses base R graphics and different options can be changed using graphical parameters (run ?par to see all the options, there are a lot). Honestly, plotProbe isn't as flexible as I'd like right now. Rewriting the function with more updated graphical options is on my todo list (probably updating it to use ggplot), hopefully over the summer.

Alex
